test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The approach driven by seven engines, which is powered by Clean Energy and ‘Sabka Prayas’ is related to which scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PM Gati Shakti's Master Plan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• A revolutionary strategy for sustainable development and economic prosperity is PM GatiShakti. Seven engines—roads, railways, airports, ports, mass transit, waterways, and logistics infrastructure—power the strategy.
 
• The Union Minister for Finance & Corporate Affairs, Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman, stated that the seven engines will work together to propel the economy ahead while presenting the Union Budget 2022–23 to Parliament today.
 
• The complementing responsibilities of energy transmission, IT communication, bulk water & sewerage, and social infrastructure support these engines.
 
• In the end, she claimed, the strategy is driven by clean energy and Sabka Prayas, the combined efforts of the federal government, state governments, and the private sector, which will provide a tonne of job and business opportunities for everyone, especially the young.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan**

 
 
• It is Launched in June 2020, the Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan aims to provide employment opportunities to migrant workers who lost their jobs during the COVID-19 pandemic and returned to their home states.
 
• The scheme focuses on creating durable assets and infrastructure in rural areas through various projects related to roads, housing, irrigation, and sanitation, thereby enhancing rural livelihoods.
 
• The initiative has a budget of approximately Rs. 50,000 crore and targets 125 days of guaranteed wage employment for each worker.
 
• It encompasses multiple states and involves local self-governments and various ministries.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana**
 
 
• It is Launched in April 2015, this scheme aims to provide financial support to small and micro enterprises by offering loans up to Rs. 10 lakh without requiring collateral, promoting entrepreneurship among the lower-income segments of society.
 
• The Mudra Yojana categorizes loans into three types: Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore (Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 5 lakh), and Tarun (Rs. 5 lakh to Rs. 10 lakh), catering to the varying needs of entrepreneurs at different stages.
 
• The scheme has facilitated millions of loans to small businesses across India, boosting self-employment and job creation while contributing to the overall economic growth of the country.
 
 
 
• **Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana**
 
 
• It is Launched in October 2020 as part of the Aatmanirbhar Bharat Package, this scheme aims to incentivize employers to create new jobs and restore jobs lost during the COVID-19 pandemic by providing financial support.
 
• Under this scheme, the government provides a subsidy to employers for the new jobs created.
 
• It covers a significant portion of the employee's provident fund contributions for a specified period, reducing the financial burden on employers.
 
• The Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana targets various sectors, focusing on encouraging the employment of women and marginalized communities, thereby promoting inclusive growth and sustainable employment opportunities.​
